description: Issue a new MCP access token scoped to another company/organisation. This does not mutate the current MCP connection: the client must use the returned token on later /mcp requests. Platform operators should prefer explicit-company admin tools when available.

companyId.description: The company ID to switch to (use list_my_companies to find available IDs)

name: switch_company

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
